meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Brand Application System: Web + iOS + Android

goal: apply locked Phases 01–07 consistently across product surfaces without redesigning locked UX baselines

shared_brand_contract.identity: same Time Trace master geometry and approved responsive logo variants
shared_brand_contract.color: same Phase 02 semantic tokens; platform system colors only when mapped deliberately
shared_brand_contract.type: same Phase 03 hierarchy/locale contracts; native platform rendering may use implementation-specific loading
shared_brand_contract.icons: same Phase 04 semantic vocabulary; platform navigation glyph conventions allowed only when semantics remain consistent
shared_brand_contract.map: same Phase 05 spatial identity and accessibility rules
shared_brand_contract.motion: same Phase 06 choreography/timing intent with platform-native implementation

web.shell: locked Global Navigation + App Shell remains authoritative
web.logo: horizontal master in wide header; compact/symbol variant at constrained widths
web.navigation: desktop nav and responsive mobile nav retain locked information architecture
web.typography: locale-aware webfont/subset loading; no CJK family shipping to unrelated locales
web.map: keyboard + synchronized accessible entity list for complex spatial views
web.motion: CSS/Web Animations/native map transitions mapped to Phase 06 tokens
web.media: responsive image pipeline; provenance rendered from backend/CMS
web.pwa: favicon/app icons use locked Phase 01 production assets

ios.shell: native navigation patterns may adapt presentation but not product hierarchy
ios.safe_area: all branded surfaces respect device safe areas and Dynamic Island/notch
ios.logo: symbol/compact lockup preferred in tight native chrome; no geometry redraw
ios.type: Dynamic Type support; hierarchy maps to Phase 03 and must survive accessibility sizes
ios.motion: Reduce Motion maps to Phase 06 reduced-motion behavior
ios.map: native gestures coexist with accessible alternate entity list
ios.icons: semantic icons preserve Phase 04 meaning; SF Symbols may be used for generic OS actions only, not to replace Dấu Việt domain glyphs
ios.media: provenance/disclosure remains visible/retrievable in native presentation

android.shell: native navigation patterns may adapt presentation but not product hierarchy
android.insets: edge-to-edge layouts respect status/navigation bars and display cutouts
android.logo: symbol/compact lockup in constrained app chrome; no geometry redraw
android.type: font scaling supported; hierarchy maps to Phase 03 and survives large text
android.touch: 48x48 dp preferred Material-compatible target; never below locked accessibility intent
android.motion: system animator/reduced-motion preferences map to Phase 06 reduced-motion behavior where available
android.map: native gestures coexist with accessible alternate entity list
android.icons: Material/system icons may serve generic OS actions only; domain semantics use Phase 04 glyphs

responsive_application.desktop: brand presence can be editorial and spacious; avoid over-branding every card
responsive_application.tablet: preserve hierarchy while reducing decorative whitespace
responsive_application.mobile: content and utility first; compact identity; no loss of provenance/state cues
responsive_application.orientation: landscape/portrait reflow must not alter semantic priority

app_icon_launch.app_icon: locked Phase 01 safe-area validated symbol; platform masks applied without redrawing geometry
app_icon_launch.splash_launch: minimal brand moment; no long cinematic gate; respect Phase 06
app_icon_launch.store_assets: brand-consistent but truthful real media; no fabricated product screenshots or misleading travel imagery

platform_specific_allowed: native text rendering and accessibility scaling
platform-native sheets/dialogs where product semantics remain intact
native haptics for direct confirmation where not required for meaning
platform_specific_prohibited: different semantic colors that change meaning
replacing domain glyphs with unrelated system icons
hiding provenance on mobile to save space
motion behavior that ignores reduced-motion contract
using platform conventions to reorder locked product hierarchy without UX justification
fake store screenshots or media that violates Phase 07
